title: A Compact xDAWN-Guided Spatio-Temporal Network with Filter-Bank Convolution for P300 Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.17101v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: P300-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) enable communication by decoding stimulus-evoked EEG responses into character selections without requiring voluntary motor output. Reliable P300 detection remains difficult because of low response amplitude and signal-to-noise ratio, while practical spellers require accurate character selection with few stimulus repetitions and low computational cost. We propose a compact deep learning architecture that combines xDAWN spatial filtering for event-related potential enhancement and dimensionality reduction, a fixed frequency-selective filter bank, and convolutional feature learning for spatio-temporal EEG decoding. Depthwise-separable convolutions and progressive average pooling reduce computational complexity while retaining discriminative temporal information. translated_title: 一种用于P300检测的紧凑型xDAWN引导时空网络与滤波器组卷积
translated_abstract: 基于P300的脑机接口（BCI）通过将刺激诱发的脑电（EEG）响应解码为字符选择来实现通信，而无需自主运动输出。由于响应幅度和信噪比很低，可靠的P300检测仍然十分困难，而实用的拼写器需要在少量刺激重复次数和低计算成本下实现准确的字符选择。我们提出了一种紧凑的深度学习架构，该架构结合了用于事件相关电位增强和降维的xDAWN空间滤波、固定频率选择的滤波器组，以及用于时空脑电解码的卷积特征学习。深度可分离卷积和渐进式平均池化在保留判别性时间信息的同时降低了计算复杂度。所得的目标/非目标分类器仅包含5,100个可训练参数。我们在两个公开基准数据集上评估了该模型……
tldr: 该论文提出一种仅含5,100个可训练参数的紧凑型深度学习网络，融合xDAWN空间滤波、固定滤波器组与深度可分离卷积，在低计算成本和少量刺激重复条件下实现高效准确的P300脑电信号检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a compact deep learning network with only 5,100 trainable parameters that combines xDAWN spatial filtering, a fixed filter bank, and depthwise-separable convolutions to achieve efficient and accurate P300 detection under low computational cost and few stimulus repetitions.
